neighbours.label: Purpose 'for' (and the noun it introduces) after something is handed or sent to a recipient to act on: 'for your review', 'for approval', 'for payment', 'for consideration'; quiet for 'for' + beneficiary, duration or object of waiting
fire: The architect submitted the revised plans to the council for approval.
A copy of the contract is enclosed for your records.
The clerk passed the complaint to the manager for action.
The samples were shipped to the laboratory for analysis.
The minutes will be circulated to all members for comment.
We have attached the schedule below for your information.
The receipts were handed to the accountant for reimbursement.
The bill was returned to the senate for signature.
quiet: The architect worked on the revised plans for three months.
A copy of the contract was made for the tenant's sister.
The clerk covered for the manager during the holidays.
The samples stayed in the laboratory for several weeks.
The members voted for the younger candidate.
We have been looking for the schedule since Monday.
The accountant bought lunch for the whole team.
The senate adjourned for the summer.

notes: Card: ' for' x13, ' to' x5, ' your' x2, ' approval'; examples 'handed to Committee for attention', 'for your convenience', 'for your approval', 'transmits the claim ... for payment'. Probes: 'forwarded to the board for approval' 1.03, 'attached for your review' 0.79, 'referred to the committee for consideration' 0.75, 'sent to the client for payment' 0.60; 'waited for the bus' 0.01, 'flowers for his mother' 0.02.
